source.title: 30 Min LOWER BODY DUMBBELL WORKOUT | Strong Legs & Glutes

notes: Checked against the video, one sample every 10 s over the whole video (the label bottom left and the ring timer top right read together), the cool-down every 3 s. The bottom-left label is the move in work and UP NEXT: <move> in the last seconds of the work and in the rest before it, so the draft starts every work about 10 s early. Warm-up of ten moves (22-213 s) shows no names after the first, so it is null (not scored). Circuit 1 and 2 are four moves of 50 s work and 10 s rest, twice, with a 25-30 s rest between rounds; circuit 3 is nine moves of 60 s work and 10 s rest; then a 20 s cycle of stretches (5 s countdown, 15 s) and Savasana. The phone ad around 1240 s is null.
